    • TierElement

      public TierElement(model.enums.TierElementStatus status)
      Constructs a TierList entry given the following parameters.
      Parameters:
      status - enum representing state The element's name will be set to DEFAULT_ELEMENT_NAME and the image path will be set to DEFAULT_ELEMENT_IMAGE_PATH

    • TierElement

      public TierElement()
      Constructs a TierList entry. The element's name will be set to DEFAULT_ELEMENT_NAME its default status will be set to TierElementStatus.UNRANKED and the image path will be set to DEFAULT_ELEMENT_IMAGE_PATH
